verdict.rationale: Vercel documents Workflows as a fully managed Workflow SDK for durable code that retries failed steps, waits for external events, and resumes across crashes and deployments. That covers durable, long-running workflows as code with built-in retries and no hand-wired queues. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation (code examples, step semantics, duration and timeout limits, explicit queue-abstraction details), and independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run as claimed.
